messages:
Maya: Non-work question for the room — if you could keep exactly ONE kitchen gadget forever (it never breaks, never needs replacing), what is it? 🧰🍳
Liam: Cast iron skillet, no contest. Heats like a dream, lasts forever. :thumbsup:
Sarah K.: Ooh tough. I pick my immersion blender for soups/sauces. Small but indispensable.
Omar: Instant Pot. All hail the pressure cooker. 1 pot = 12 meals.
Joel: Coffee grinder. I will fight for fresh beans. ☕️
Maya: @Liam love the cast iron vote. @Sarah K. immersion blender is underrated. @Omar huge energy. @Joel coffee grinder = life.
Liam: Bonus: cast iron can double as a pan and a skillet for camping.
Sarah K.: Also, it ages like a person — better with years.
Omar: Poll idea: weekend test — bring your gadget to the office kitchen and demo? :raised_hands:
Maya: Haha yes. Office demo day. We can have stickers for the winner.
Lunchbot: Reminder: free lunch in the kitchen fridge until 2pm today. :fork_and_knife:
Joel: If I bring my grinder I'm bringing beans. Trade?
Maya: Deal. 10am at the kitchen counter, bring something to share if you can.
Liam: Quick follow-up: what’s the most surprising thing that gadget does that people don’t expect?
Sarah K.: Immersion blender = whipped cream in 30s, you heard it here.
Omar: Instant Pot can make yogurt (wild).
Joel: Fresh grounds = better iced coffee that doesn't taste like sadness.
Maya: Cool — see y'all 10am. Maybe we should make a tiny bracket? "The Gadget Games".
Liam: Love it. Bracket, stickers, and coffee. 
Sarah K.: :trophy:
Omar: :sunglasses:
Maya: Closing note: this is a strictly non-work, very important initiative.
